items.text: Wiring fix (approach A): install Playwright version-matched chromium to persistent PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/projects/.cache/ms-playwright (HOME is ephemeral); no change to world.ts
devfile.yaml env: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/projects/.cache/ms-playwright for durability across workspace recreation
pnpm a2o:setup idempotent install script: playwright install chromium only when absent at the path; safe to re-run; ~1min/~170MB first run, no-op thereafter
look primitive genesis/a2o/scripts/look.ts (pnpm look <url> [--as FixtureHuman] [--doorway] [--wait-testid] [--out] [--viewport]) reusing PlaywrightDevice capture
look behavior: launch via world.ts call; fail-fast with exact remediation if browser missing; PlaywrightDevice.init capture wiring; optional fixture-human login; goto+wait+screenshot; exit 0 when ok

look output to reports/look/<latest|slug>/: shot.png (multimodal Read) + capture.json (url/finalUrl/title/ok/as/viewport/waitedFor/durationMs/console/pageErrors/failedRequests); gitignored; format fixed as L2 contract
Files touched: devfile.yaml env, package.json a2o:setup+look scripts, look.ts new, gitignore reports/look/, a2o/CLAUDE.md Tools entry; no change to world.ts/device classes/selectors/.feature

Verification: a2o:setup installs+re-run no-op; look against doorway-alpha produces ok-true shot; look --as Matthew --wait-testid proves auth path; one @browser cucumber renders locally not hangs; browser-missing fail-fast with exact command
